items.title: Edwards Lifesciences (EW) Trial Data Points To Earlier TAVR Use In Moderate Aortic Stenosis
items.summary: Edwards Lifesciences (NYSE:EW) reported new PROGRESS Trial data showing transcatheter aortic valve replacement outperformed active surveillance in moderate aortic stenosis. The trial linked TAVR use in moderate aortic stenosis with fewer combined outcomes of death or heart failure events in at-risk patients.
